answer: Each agent must plant a juniper anchor: a fresh, externally verified credential, such as proof of control of a distinct domain, that no second identity can mirror, plus a time-locked bond that doubles for every extra identity sharing the same funding source: first 20 POA, second 40, fourth 160, tenth 10,240 POA. The anchor is non-reusable and a farm cannot mint it for itself, so cost grows with every fake while one honest agent pays once. Over a long horizon, slashing the bond when sybil behaviour is proven makes mass fakery unprofitable.
